paragraphs.text: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin: answers ask_user_question with the recommended option when nobod
y replies in time, so an unattended session keeps working.
# dsh-plugin-auto-answer
**Unattended DSH sessions don't stall on `ask_user_question`.**

When nobody answers a question within a configurable window, this Host plugin claims
the request wit

h the option the asker recommended — the `(Recommended)` / `（推荐）`
label — and the agent keeps workin

g. If you *do* answer in time, your answer passes
through untouched and the plugin never intervenes.
Host-only bundle: nothing renders in the page, no browser half, no dependencies.

> **Known UI behaviour, by design — not a bug:** with a browser page attached, the question
> card s

tays on screen after an automatic answer until you dismiss it (「提交」/「跳过」 or a
> page reload). The an

swer is already recorded and the turn has continued; see
> *“The question card stays on screen after
an automatic answer”* below.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`dsh plugin add` writes the package into the profile and selects its bundle layer, so
the row shows

up in the GUI's Plugins page and in `dsh --profile web --dump-config`
(`# == dsh-plugin-auto-answer`
→ `id: auto-answer`).

Installing a new bundle activates it through HMR. **Replacing an installed copy of this
plugin needs

a `dsh web` restart**: Host module code is cached per process, so a changed
`lib/index.js` is not r
eloaded by a re-apply.
## How it works

`ask_user_question` is dispatched as the `user-questions/request` waterfall. The browser
UI answers
it by rendering a question card; in a headless run nothing answers it at all.

This plugin registers **in front of** that chain (`prepend`) and calls `next()` — it is a
proxy, not

gin registers **in front of** that chain (`prepend`) and calls `next()` — it is a
proxy, not a veto:
| what happens | result |

| a human answers inside the window | their answer wins, unchanged |
| nobody answers before the dea

dline | the recommended option is submitted |
| the next answerer fails outright (`NO_PROVIDER` with

no page, transport ended) | the window keeps running, then the recommended option is submitted |
|
the tool's own timed window expired (`ASK_TIMED_OUT`) | the recommended option is submitted immediat

ely instead of returning `pending` |
| the turn is cancelled (`ASK_ABORTED`, signal aborted) | propa
gated — a cancelled turn is never answered |

The listener is registered with `{ global: true, prepend: true }`. The global flag is not
optional:

Agent events are scope-filtered by the context a listener was registered on, and
a plugin installed

through the plugin manager is applied inside one agent's scope — without
it the plugin would only an
swer the session that installed it.
## Which option counts as "recommended"

- An option label ending in `(Recommended)`, `（推荐）`, `(推荐)` or `（Recommended）`,
case-insensitively.

The option does **not** have to be first.
- The label is submitted verbatim: the marker stays in the

answer, because it is the value
the asker offered.
- Multi-select questions take every marked optio

n.
- No marked option → `fallback` decides: `first` (default), `last`, or `none` (never answer,
leav

e the question to a human).
- A question without options has nothing to choose: `freeText: skip` sub

mits an empty
selection — the protocol's own "skipped" answer — while `block` leaves it open.
- `pla

n-review` intents are **ignored by default**: approving a plan is a decision with
consequences. `pla

nReview: approve` / `decline` opt in explicitly.
- A batch is answered only when every question in i

t can be answered; the answer contract
requires one item per question, and a partial batch would hid

the answer contract
requires one item per question, and a partial batch would hide a human decision.
## Config
All keys are optional; the row's `config` overrides the defaults.
| key | default | meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | master switch; `false` registers no listener at all |
| `timeoutSeconds` | `1

20` | window before the recommended option is chosen (5 – 86400) |
| `fallback` | `first` | `first`

\| `last` \| `none` when no option is marked |
| `freeText` | `skip` | `skip` \| `block` for questio

ns without options |
| `planReview` | `ignore` | `ignore` \| `approve` \| `decline` for plan reviews

without options |
| `planReview` | `ignore` | `ignore` \| `approve` \| `decline` for plan reviews |

**With the tool's own `timed` mode**, keep `timeoutSeconds` below `tool-ask-user`'s
`timeout`; other

wise the tool returns `pending` first and this plugin's answer never
applies. The default blocking t
ool has no such constraint.
## Observability

Host logs in `dsh web` are not visible in the terminal, so the plugin writes an optional
JSONL trace

ost logs in `dsh web` are not visible in the terminal, so the plugin writes an optional
JSONL trace:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Events: `armed`, `answered`, `delegated` (a human answered), `delegate_error`, `failed`.
A broken tr
ace path never breaks the question it describes.
## Verified behaviour

Offline self-test (`node selftest.mjs`) — 39 checks over the package contract, config
normalisation,

the recommendation rules, the registration options, the timer races, and
"No unhandled rejection /

on rules, the registration options, the timer races, and
"No unhandled rejection / no leaked timer".

Real installation path: installed into a throwaway profile with `dsh plugin add`, confirmed
as a bun

dle layer and row in `dsh --profile … --dump-config`, and visible on the GUI's
Plugins page under 已安

row in `dsh --profile … --dump-config`, and visible on the GUI's
Plugins page under 已安装 → 无人值守自动应答.
End-to-end on a live host (blocking tool as shipped):

- **unattended**: 20 s window, question left open — the trace shows `armed` →
`answered` exactly 20.

003 s later with the recommended option, and the turn finished in
22 s with *"你最终选择了蓝色（Recommended）。

"*
- **attended**: 60 s window, the human picked the non-recommended option 24 s in — the trace
show

s `armed` → `delegated (answered-by-ui)`, the turn finished with *"你最终选了香蕉。"*,
and the card collapse
d to `1/1 已回答` normally.
